# sfcompute_pool_transfers (Data Source)

Reads pool transfers from SF Compute (`GET /v2/pool_transfers`). All pages are fetched unless `limit`, `starting_after` or `ending_before` is set.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ending_before` (String) Set to the response's `cursor` to fetch the previous page.
- `limit` (Number)
- `pool` (List of String) Filter by source or destination pool (repeatable). Returns transfers where the source or destination pool is any of the supplied pools.
- `starting_after` (String) Set to the response's `cursor` to fetch the next page.
- `status` (String) Filter by transfer status.

### Read-Only

- `cursor` (String)
- `data` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `has_more` (Boolean)

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `allocation_schedule_delta` (Attributes List) The transfer's allocation schedule, expanded into constant-quantity rectangles. The final rectangle has `end_at: null` (the unbounded tail); gaps are represented as explicit zero-quantity rectangles. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--allocation_schedule_delta))
- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `from_pool` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `rejected_reason` (String) Reason a pool transfer was rejected.
- `sku` (Attributes) SKU the transfer applied to. Carries the SKU's human-readable name when one is registered. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--sku))
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status of a pool transfer.
- `to_pool` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--data--allocation_schedule_delta"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.allocation_schedule_delta`

Read-Only:

- `end_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `node_count` (Number)
- `start_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.


<a id="nestedatt--data--sku"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.sku`

Read-Only:

- `alias` (String) A short, unique among live, human-recognizable name for this SKU. For display only - reference the SKU by `id`.
- `id` (String)
